title: World Bloom — In an Ephemeral Embrace — Episode7 To Be Myself

meta.Event Outline: Several days before the meeting in the Asahina family household, the members of Nightcord at 25:00 notice something strange happening to the tree in their SEKAI. They each soon find themselves dreaming of very different lives.

rows.Line: A few days later
Diner

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Today's event was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Every booth was so cute that I wanted to stay there forever!

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line:
I know what you mean!
Speaking of which, Amia, you sell your works at a shop, right? Makes sense, with that level of quality!

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line: Yeah! I've bought one of your creations myself♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Thanks!
It's nice to see people like you two wearing the stuff I made.

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line: I'm really looking forward to seeing what you make next! Do you already have an event in mind?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm... Not yet.
My next one might take me a little while.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've actually gotten into making clothes lately.

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Wait, you're making clothes now?! That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm still just getting started, so they're really nothing special!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Starting from scratch is a lot harder than I thought it would be.
I'm working on a dress right now, but it's nowhere near ready.

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: What?! Can I reserve it?!

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line: Hey, no fair!

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: But we're talking a dress made by Amia! I know it's going to be absolutely adorable!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks!
But I'm not sure I can accept money for it since it's just the first one. I can't guarantee quality.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It'd take even more time to get it to a level where I'd be comfy with someone wearing it.

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Aw, okay...

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Oh, then, why don't we make it together?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line:
I'm actually really good at sewing.
I've even made my own clothes in the past!

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: If we work together, Amia, then I'm sure we'll be able to create some really adorable outfits!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, I kinda want to focus on working solo right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But maybe we'll get a chance sometime in the future♪

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Aww...! That's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Still, I can't wait to see how your dress turns out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Phew, that was fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's nice having people around I can talk about cute things with.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I was a little surprised when she asked me to make that dress with her, though...)
Mizuki?
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rui...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Long time no see.
Did you just get out of school?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I was about to head over for practice.
I had a committee meeting, so I wasn't able to leave until a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, nifty.
What are you working on now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We've been training with the Morinomiya Revue.
It's been hard, but also very enjoyable.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, THE Morinomiya Revue?!
That's awesome!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We were fortunate enough to get an introduction.
And now, we get to learn and train together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, things are going well with Tsukasa and the others?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm honestly surprised myself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope you guys all get to make your dreams come true together!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Me too. We're working toward them together, step by step.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki... Are you sure you won't come back to school?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Because I'm having so much fun right now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, I'll also support your decision.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'm this way.
Good luck with practice♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, be seeing you.
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Rui sounds like he's really enjoying life.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (He has friends he can count on now. Not like before.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Still, going back there...

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Hey look, you-know-who's here today!
Talk about girlier than your average girl, just like everyone says.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
I mean, it's not like I care.
I just feel like if you don't want people talking about you, maybe you should dress like a normal person.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line:
Why even dress that way anyway?
Desperate for attention much?

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: It's probably better to keep your distance. Who knows what people might think?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Things are so much easier now that I'm not going to school anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I get to dress how I feel, make whatever I want and watch whatever I like.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I get to be free. I get to be myself...
Which is way more fun.)

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Oh, then, why don't we make it together?

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line:
I'm actually really good at sewing.
I've even made my own clothes in the past!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Getting too involved with others...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's just more trouble than it's worth.
se_event_wl_2nd_schoolrefusal_2025_003
se_event_wl_2nd_schoolrefusal_2025_003

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Is someone singing...? But where...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't know, but it felt like such a gentle song...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I've gotta get home and continue working on that dress!
